title: Native condensed scalar equivalence and the finite comparison record
statement: Let ell be prime and X a scheme. Define condensedNativeMap from the condensed algebraic-closure coefficient to the native abelian coefficient as globalCoefficientIso followed by padicAlgClSheafToAdicConstantSheaf. It is an isomorphism. Define nativeCondensedModules as native scalar forgetting followed by restriction along this map, and nativeCondensedDerived by deriving this exact additive equivalence. For a normalized native functor D, define CondensedStageComparison to be the data of finite full faithful functors from raw rational finite stages to bounded constructible condensed finite-coefficient categories, scalar natural isomorphisms, object isomorphisms after closure extension, and the common-stage representative equation conjugating the finite arrow by those object and scalar comparisons and the specified closure tensor associators. This is the unchanged record used by the finite condensed stage comparison theorem.

proof.text: Construct the ring map from the condensed closure coefficient to the native abelian coefficient as globalCoefficientIso followed by padicAlgClSheafToAdicConstantSheaf. Both factors are isomorphisms. Compose native scalar forgetting with restriction along this map, then derive the resulting additive equivalence. This is the actual H in the statement, defined without choosing data from an existence theorem.
